In a single-round auction with independent value draws, the optimal strategy is to bid close to, but not exceeding, my private value. Since my value is $17, I'll bid strategically around that point. Other rational bidders will likely do the same. I'll aim to bid just above the expected midpoint of potential bids, around $15-$18, to maximize my chances of winning without overpaying. The key is balancing winning probability with potential profit margin.
